book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: JESUCRISTONꞋ BZEJNI'IDEꞋ SAN JUANṈAꞋ C̱HE DAꞋ CAꞋ ZAꞋ GAC

content: Beṉe' Israel ca' beṉe' zjanyiše' seyw c̱he Diosen'
Gwdena' ble'eda' tap angl zjazeche' tap squin c̱he yežlion' bosozague' ben' cont bi gwyec̱hjen ḻo yežlion', ḻo nisdaon' o gan' ze yag ca'.

Na' ble'eda' yeto angl beṉe' za' gan' chla' gwbiž na' nox̱e' to da' gwc̱hine' gwc̱hiše'de' seyw c̱he Dios ḻoxga beṉe' ca' chesonxen ḻe', Dios beṉe' zoa toḻi tocaṉe. Na' anglen' gwṉe' zižje boḻ güiže' angl ca' tap ben' zjanac ḻo ne'e yesone' gac yeḻa' zi' ḻo yežlion' len ḻo nisdaon'.
Gože' ḻegaque': ―Bi gwžiayi'le yežlion', ṉe nisdaon', ṉe yag ca' šlac biṉa' gwc̱hiša' seyw c̱he Dios c̱hecho ḻoxga beṉe' ca' chesonxen ḻe'.
Na' benda' gwne' baḻ beṉe' bc̱hiše' seyon' beṉe' za'ac ḻo yogo' diaža c̱he beṉe' Israel, na' yogüe' gosac to gayoa tapeyon mile'.
Šižiṉw mile' za'aque' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Judá, šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Rubén, šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Gad,
na' šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Aser, šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Neftalí, šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Manasés,
na' šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Simeón, šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Leví, šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Isacar,
šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Zabulón, šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' José na' šižiṉw mile' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Benjamín.

Na' gwdena' gwṉa'a da' yoble na' ble'eda' zjaze beṉe' zan lao Diosen' gan' chi'e chnabi'e na' lao ben' zaca'lebde' ca xila' daon' be gosot beṉe' Israel ṉec̱he xtoḻa'gaque'. Na' nono goc yosolab baḻ beṉe' že', ḻe gosaque' beṉe' zan juisyw, beṉe' to to nación, to to yež, to to diaža, na' gosaque' beṉe' chesac gwde gwdele diža' da' de ḻo yezlion'. Na' yogüe' zjanyaze' lache' šiš na' zjanox̱e' zin.

content.text: X̱anto' Dios ben' chi' chnabia' na' Jesucristw ben' zaca'lebde' ca xila' daon' be gosot beṉe' Israel ṉec̱he xtoḻa'gaque',
ḻegaque' ba gosoṉe' yeḻa' mban c̱hecho toḻi tocaṉe.

content: Nach yogo'ḻoḻ angl ca' zjaze' cue'ej cuite' gan' chi'e chnabi'e, na' beṉe' blao ca' tapechoa na' beṉe' ca' tap zjažia x̱il, yogo'ḻoḻe' jasechaze' cosc̱ho'ale ḻo yon' gosonxene' Diosen',

content.text: Chac can' cheyaḻa' gac, Dios c̱heto'.
zaco' güe'to' yeḻa' chox̱clen c̱hio' na' güe'to' yeḻa' bala'aṉ c̱hio' toḻi tocaṉe,
chnabi'o doxen, na' napo' ḻa'zelagüe yeḻa' guac xen.

content: Nach to beṉe' blao ben' nac txen len beṉe' tapechoa ca' gože'nda': ―¿Ṉezdo' no zjanac beṉe' quinga zjanyaz lache' šiš na' ga za'aque'?

Na' boži'an goša'ne': ―Le' ṉezdo' beṉe' gole, bi ṉezda' neda'. Nach gože' neda': ―Beṉe' quinga ba gosaḻe'de' da' ba gosac c̱hegaque' yežlion'. Na' bac̱h gwnitlao xtoḻa'gaque' na' ba zjanyaze' lache' šiš, ḻe chesejnilaže' Jesucristw ben' blalj xc̱hene' ca xila' dao' be gosot beṉe' Israel cont bezi'xen Diosen' xtoḻa'gaque'.
Da'nan' nite' lao Diosen' gan' chi'e chnabi'en chesonxene' ḻe' do ža do yel. Na' Dios ben' chi' chnabi'e zoe' chape' ḻegaque'.
Bich yesebiḻ yesedone', na' gwbižen' bich gwzeyen ḻegaque', ṉeca yesacde' zeye'.

Ḻe Jesucristw ben' zaca'lebde' ca xila' daon' ben' gosot beṉe' Israel ṉec̱he xtoḻa'gaque', ḻen' chgüia chṉe'e ḻegaque'. Ze' lao Diosen' gachoḻ gan' chi'e chnabi'e na' gone' cont ṉita'chgüe' mbalaz. Gone' cont bich yesebeže' ṉeca yesegüine'de'.
